sources.catalogueEvidence: Season catalogue matches SKU L49189200+ and gives lengths 156/164/172/180/188, geometry, radii, midsole positions and single-ski weights. Catalogue says the weights exclude bindings.
sources.productPageEvidence: Official Salomon page gives the complete six-size geometry and radii for 148/156/164/172/180/188 plus net weights 2940/3160/3370/3560/3760/4000 g. The listed net weights match twice the catalogue single-ski weights for the five overlapping sizes, so stored weightPerPair is the page's pair-level net weight.
limitations: The 148 cm option is present on the official product page but absent from the season catalogue's per-ski weight and midsole rows.
No weight or midsole value is inferred for 148 cm.
